style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: सम्मूढ, free of delusion, is the key to knowing the Supreme
यः, the one who, starts a chain from knowing to worshiping
knowing Krishna as Purushottama is the whole point of the teaching

angle_hi: असम्मूढ, जो मोह से मुक्त है

en.intro: Krishna has just finished describing the Supreme Self beyond all change. Now he tells Arjuna what happens when a person truly sees him.
en.notice: Whoever knows Krishna as Purushottama, free of confusion, worships him with their whole being.
en.next: Krishna then closes this section by declaring that knowing this secret teaching makes a person wise and completes all their duties.
en.meaning: Arjuna, the one who is free from confusion and knows Me as the Supreme Self, worships Me with all his being.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी परमेश्वर का स्वरूप बताया है जो सब बदलावों से परे है। अब वे अर्जुन को बताते हैं कि जब कोई व्यक्ति उन्हें सही से पहचान लेता है तो क्या होता है।
hi.meaning: हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन, जो मनुष्य मोहरहित होकर मुझे पुरुषोत्तम जानता है, वह सब कुछ जानने वाला होकर सर्वभावेन मेरी ही पूजा करता है।
hi.notice: इस श्लोक में पहला शब्द है यः, यानी जो। जो व्यक्ति मुझे पुरुषोत्तम जानता है वह असम्मूढ होता है, और यह स्पष्ट ज्ञान ही उसे सर्वभावेन मेरी पूजा करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण इस गूढ़ ज्ञान को बताकर इस अध्याय की समाप्ति करते हैं कि इसे जानने से व्यक्ति ज्ञानी हो जाता है और उसका सारा कर्म पूरा हो जाता है।

en.intro: Krishna has just finished describing the Supreme Self beyond all change. Now he tells Arjuna what happens when a person truly sees him.
en.body: Arjuna, the one who is free from confusion and knows Me as the Supreme Self, worships Me with all his being. Whoever knows Krishna as Purushottama, free of confusion, worships him with their whole being. Krishna then closes this section by declaring that knowing this secret teaching makes a person wise and completes all their duties.

issues: meaning_changed: "वह सब कुछ जानने वाला होकर सर्वभावेन मेरी ही पूजा करता है" (The Hindi translation adds the phrase 'सब कुछ जानने वाला होकर' (becoming all-knowing), which is not present in the source verse. The source says 'सर्ववित् भजति' (all-knowing worships), not that the person becomes all-knowing. This changes the meaning from 'all-knowing worships' to 'the person becomes all-knowing and worships'.)

meaning_changed: "हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन, जो मनुष्य मोहरहित होकर मुझे पुरुषोत्तम जानता है, वह सर्ववित् होकर सर्वभावेन मेरी ही पूजा करता है।" (The Hindi translation adds the word 'सर्ववित्' (all-knowing) to describe the person, which is not present in the Sanskrit source (Sanskrit has 'स सर्ववित्' meaning 'he, being all-knowing', not 'he becomes all-knowing'). This changes the grammatical structure and meaning of the verse.)

contrast_template: "जो व्यक्ति मुझे पुरुषोत्तम जानता है वह असम्मूढ होता है, और यह स्पष्ट ज्ञान ही उसे सर्वभावेन मेरी पूजा करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।" (The notice uses the Hindi word 'ही' (indeed/only/just) which implies a contrastive or exclusive meaning ('and this clear knowing itself/only inspires him'), whereas the source simply states that clear knowing leads to worship without contrasting it with other things.)

wrong_fact: "next: 'कृष्ण इस गूढ़ ज्ञान को बताकर इस अध्याय की समाप्ति करते हैं कि इसे जानने से व्यक्ति ज्ञानी हो जाता है और उसका सारा कर्म पूरा हो जाता है।'" (This notice describes the content of the NEXT verse (verse 20) as if it belongs to this verse. The next verse states that knowing this secret teaching makes a person wise and accomplishes all their duties. However, this verse (verse 19) focuses on the one who knows Krishna as Purushottama being free from delusion and worshipping Him with all their being.)
